title: cymopterus glomeratus
intro: Cymopterus glomeratus, commonly known as cluster umbel, is a perennial plant species in the carrot family (Apiaceae). It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly for its ability to relieve respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma. The health benefits of cluster umbel include its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties, which help to reduce congestion and promote the removal of mucus from the lungs. The bioactive constituents of Cymopterus glomeratus include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as bronchodilation and cough suppression.
